revision_note: Active OpenCode-native CTF agent with persistent interactive TCP sessions, reproducible core/pwn worker images, Kimi-orchestrator/DeepSeek Flash 1017 executor routing with a constrained provider policy, remote scope/expiry/TLS controls, an independent evidence evaluator, a deterministic progress signal with evidence-gated escalation, explicit requested/effective budgets, durable analysis-job reuse, paired adversarial execution, a deterministic deception detector and quarantine of poisoned memory. V3.1 qualification reran one original service and does not establish superiority. V3.2 revalidated four eligible original tasks (replay-verified reverse plus three equality-based operator-flag services); web-xod-revenge is blocked because an unchanged solver-controlled callback/DNS path is unproven. The original five-task/30-run matrix was not executed. OpenCode V2 now uses mcp.servers with direct tools; a model-free capture proved sandbox_exec in the B tool list. The 24-job dry run passed all view/checker/service checks and recorded no model attempts. 403 default tests passing, 10 opt-in skips; no benchmark result or solve is claimed. The V3.2 four-task matrix then completed 24/24 durable records (19 paid attempts, 5 pre-model infrastructure failures, 0 verified solves); pwn pairs are non-comparable because of reset-readiness false negatives. An offline diagnostic classified all 24 records and 20 failed tool calls, and a bounded greeting-based TCP readiness helper replaced the false-negative reset probe; 24/24 offline post-fix restarts passed. A separate 12-job pwn+crypto expanded cohort (seed 20261118) passed a no-solver dry run; reverse/web/forensics/misc candidates remain blocked.
